meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档变成 NotebookLM 生成的 kawaii 风格幻灯片 PDF,存成源文件同目录下的 <源文件名>-slides.pdf。若配置了 WOWerpoint 服务器,还会上传这份 PDF,并返回一个竖屏手机版分享链接。
howto.when: 当你说「Wowerpoint <文件>」「把这份报告变成幻灯片」「Kawaii-deck this」等,或要求把单个文档渲染成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.text: 把这份报告变成幻灯片
say.note: 产出 kawaii 叙事幻灯片 PDF

say.text: 换个提示词重做这份幻灯片
say.note: 复用已有 notebook,只重跑生成和下载

howto.what_en: Turns one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF saved next to the source as <source-stem>-slides.pdf. If the WOWerpoint server env vars are set, it also uploads the PDF and returns a 9:16 mobile share URL.
howto.when_en: Use it when you say "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or otherwise ask to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Produces a kawaii narrative slide-deck PDF

say_en.text: Regenerate the deck with a different prompt
say_en.note: Reuses the notebook, reruns generate and download
